rows.grounds: neuter accusative singular passive participle from jñā
compound of śukti and mātraka in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What quantities of fish, meat, and blood are prescribed as known Kaula offerings?
premises: the measure is only a shellful
items.inference: The verse fixes the Kaula offering measure for fish, meat, and blood at a shellful.
uncertainties: whether śuktimātrakam modifies all three items or only blood
whether jñeyaṃ is a separate prescription or a gloss on the list
items.plain_english: Fish, meat, and blood are to be known, with the measure being only a shellful.
